model.jaffle_shop.exposed_view.why: exposures read it (products_dashboard): it stays a view for them, and its readers that move (1) read a table of it

model.jaffle_shop.heavy_view.why: its plan holds memory (a join, aggregate, sort or window): built once as a table

model.jaffle_shop.shared_view.why: 2 models read it: built once as a table, read by each

model.jaffle_shop.stg_locations.why: its one reader is all that reads it and its plan only streams: inlined into it, nothing to store or build

model.jaffle_shop.stuck_view.why: it can't move itself (syntax:semi_structured, materialization:view); a table of it built on Snowflake lets its readers move (1), and the view stays
